messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>

Subject: PO profile & vendor intake: timeline and itemization ask

Hi Jared —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor setup with us. We want to confirm a handful of PO-related requirements so finance and your procurement team align on issuance timing and the line-item structure. High-level asks below: 

1) Vendor identity & tax documents: confirm the legal business name, remit address, and tax ID (EIN/VAT). We usually request a W-9 (US) or W-8 / local equivalent for non-US vendors.

2) PO number format: does ProcureCo require us to supply a specific PO number pattern, or will you accept our generated POs (suggested pattern: RDW-YYYY-####)?

3) Mandatory PO fields: please confirm which fields you must see on the PO to trigger payment (examples: invoice reference, SLA code, project code, GL code).

4) Line-item structure: our preference is one visible line per SKU/feature with these columns: sku / description / unit_of_measure / qty / unit_price / extended_total / tax_code. If your AP requires different columns (e.g., contract line IDs or split billing), let us know.

5) Timeline: target vendor activation in our system within 10 business days of receiving the completed intake. Estimated PO issuance: 48-72 hours after vendor activation + SOW acceptance. If you need a faster path for the initial PO, please flag that.

I've attached our Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf to streamline the capture of the fields above. Can you complete ProcureCo's supplier profile and return it by EOD next Thursday (2026-08-13)? If helpful, let’s grab a short call — calendaring link: https://cal.com/redwood/30min

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

Vivek — thanks for the clear checklist.

Quick clarifications from our side:
- We will attach ProcureCo_Supplier_Profile.xlsx (sending with this message) — that has fields for bank details, tax id, and remit address.
- Our AP team would like the PO to include a 6-digit internal project code when present; is that something you can map to the SOW or metadata on your side?
- PO number: ProcureCo can accept your RDW-YYYY-#### pattern, but if you can also provide a short reference (<=16 chars) in the invoice reference field that speeds reconciliation.

We do standard GL codes on invoices — not required on the PO for all vendors, but helpful. Will your team be able to provide a GL mapping column in the line-item export?

Call: I can do 11:30am PT tomorrow.

Thanks — Jared

Jared — appreciate the quick reply and the attach. A few operational points from Redwood finance/procurement: 

- Required docs: legal name, remit address, tax ID (EIN or VAT), and a completed vendor W-9/W-8 as applicable. We will need a scanned signature for onboarding.
- PO format: we use RDW-YYYY-#### as our canonical PO identifier (finance will also accept your reference in the invoice_reference field).
- Line-item guidance: please provide one row per deliverable. Our minimum recommended columns: contract_line_id | sku | description | unit_of_measure | quantity | unit_price | extended_total | tax_code | gl_code(optional). If ProcureCo can add a project_code column we will map that to the SOW.
- Invoice matching: our AP team does a 2-way match by default; if you include line-level totals and tax_code we can avoid unnecessary rework.

Timeline (procurment ops):
- Target: vendor profile returned within 5 business days (by 2026-08-14).
- Vendor activation in Redwood: within 2 business days of complete docs.
- Initial PO issuance: within 48-72 hours of activation, pending SOW approval from the owning product team.

I've attached two artifacts to speed this: PO_Lineitem_Template.csv (column headers and sample row) and Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.md (simple checklist for documents we need). Dev Patel (cc'd) will be the processing lead for the PO once the profile is active — Dev, please confirm bank detail verification SLA.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
